purpose: Compress related FIELD dimensions into one coherent held manipulation space without allowing geometry, projection, animation, or control count to manufacture domain meaning.
law: Related dimensions may share one held manipulation space when meaning is carried by named state and host-defined relative transforms; compression must preserve identity, gesture ownership, reversibility/residue, provenance, and causal RETURN.

definitions.axis: A continuous reversible dimension of meaningful host state.
definitions.coaxial_object: One coherent state-bearing thing through which two or more related axes can be read or manipulated; not necessarily circular or one DOM object.
definitions.relative_state: A named relation derived from two or more axes, such as alignment, phase, distance, enclosure, exposure, or temporal offset.
definitions.held_state: The currently addressed state owned by the user/host; projections may render it but do not become its authority.
definitions.exposure: How much latent structure is currently perceptible/manipulable.
definitions.coupling: An explicit host-owned rule by which one axis influences another.

invariants.law: STATE != VIEW. Current state must be representable independently of rendering.
Relative transforms may carry meaning only through an explicit host/domain mapping; carrier geometry alone supplies no semantic verb.
ONE GESTURE -> ONE PRIMARY INTERPRETATION. Secondary coupling must be explicit and legible.
ROUTE/SCALE/FOLD/BLOOM preserve addressed identity unless traversal explicitly changes the referent.
Cheap/local transforms are reversible; FOLD preserves enough residue for exact or declared-tolerance BLOOM.
LIVE may drive state but user/source/system contributions remain distinguishable; borrowed clock != borrowed authorship.
RETURN records enough before/operation/actor/delta/after/provenance to explain the present state.
A coaxial mechanism must remove more exposed interaction complexity than it adds.

operators.ROUTE: Change addressed position while retaining context; traversal is explicit.
operators.SCALE: Change resolution/aperture while keeping the referent traceable.
operators.FOLD: Reduce exposed dimensionality without deleting recoverable state.
operators.BLOOM: Expose latent/derived dimensions with provenance; do not invent feature layers.
operators.LIVE: Evolve transforms through time under explicit driver provenance.
operators.RETURN: Preserve causal transformation lineage; destination-only snapshots are insufficient.

failure_modes: AXIS_INFLATION: every variable becomes a ring/dial/axis.
DECORATIVE_COAXIALITY: nested geometry has no meaningful relational behavior.
SEMANTIC_LEAKAGE: a generic carrier maps geometry directly to domain verbs.
GESTURE_COLLISION: one motion silently mutates unrelated dimensions.
STATE_VIEW_CONFUSION: projection changes are mistaken for canonical state changes.
FOLD_AMNESIA: compression destroys information required to reopen.
BLOOM_BLOAT: expansion is a feature drawer rather than exposure of latent state.
LIVE_DECORATION: animation moves without meaningful state evolution.
RETURN_THEATRE: history stores snapshots but cannot reconstruct cause.
FALSE_COMPRESSION: the clever mechanism costs more attention/learning than the controls it replaces.

implementation.carrier_rule: Generic carriers expose coordinates, relations, gates, distances, and transforms. Hosts own semantic mappings.
implementation.compatibility_note: InterphaseRing.relationVerb remains legacy compatibility for existing callers; new generic work must not rely on its default BLOOM/FOLD/RETURN/SPLIT mapping.
implementation.acceptance: A design passes only when invariants A-H all hold; failure of H means it may be interesting but is not justified by COAXIALITY.
implementation.admission_rule: A mechanism may claim COAXIALITY PASS only when the executable audit computes KEEP. INDETERMINATE is not PASS; H_COMPRESSION failure requires de-coaxialization/deletion rather than explanation chrome.
